name: Scroll Color Changer
description: Full-screen scroll sections with parallax image and text blocks, where the page background and text color transition to each section's colors as it scrolls into view, with a hero opener.
contents: Hero section with parallax background image, tagline and large heading
Alternating image and text sections, each with tagline and heading
behavior: Smooth scrolling through Locomotive Scroll with per-element parallax speeds
Page background and text color tween to each section's colors when it reaches 40% of the viewport
Scrolling back up restores the previous section's colors
Section images zoom slightly on hover
editableByProps: Number of sections, taglines, headings, heading sizes, images and alt text
Background and text color per section
Color transition duration, smooth scroll speed and parallax speed per section

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the scroll trigger point for color changes
Change hero or content section layout

fixed: Changes the page body background and text color while mounted and resets them on unmount
Takes over page scrolling with Locomotive Scroll, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Injects a global style block for html and body overflow used by smooth scrolling
